description: Saw the gap in the loaf and left the unread page unread.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Measured the loaf, asked with it in her hand, and did not collect the firing sixpence.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Ate, and left the letters to the people who write them.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Heard in the service. He did not speak to you.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Preached seven heads and stopped at one turning of the glass.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Paid threepence, kept the letter, and offered no new plot.
name: William Shakespeare
